items.title: UK net migration at lowest level since 1997 as asylum claims also fall
items.summary: Net migration figures of 77,000 in the year to the end of June mark the lowest this century outside of the Covid pandemic.

items.title: Witnesses contacted as US probe into World Cup sell-off plan intensifies
items.summary: A planned US congressional investigation into FIFA and Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off plans is intensifying with requests to speak to current and former FIFA staff, Sky News…

items.title: Burnham says UK net migration now under 'sufficient' control
items.summary: It comes after annual net migration fell to 77,000 - the lowest level this century, excluding the coronavirus pandemic.

items.title: Airline suspends all flights - as carrier faces bankruptcy
items.summary: Norse Atlantic Airways has suspended all flights, with the company saying it could file for bankruptcy unless an urgent solution to its finances is found.

items.title: Drug rape husband says wife 'would have been terrified', court hears
items.summary: The husband has told a jury that his wife "would never agree to do any of this".

items.title: Charity set up in honour of Princess Diana placed into administration
items.summary: A charity set up in tribute to the late Princess Diana has been placed into administration.
